title: Damage entity item effect outcome
description: Attempts to damage the given entity. Keep in mind that this would be a different damage instance from a triggering attack and it will be affected by invulnerability frames.

amount.$comment: The amount of damage to deal, can be a decimal value

damageType.$comment: A resource location referencing a damage type, the damage type has significant impact on how the damage is dealt. Datapacks can define their own damage types. More info on damage types here: https://minecraft.wiki/w/Damage_type
